# HK Miles

> Hong Kong's most complete credit card miles and cashback intelligence platform. Daily-updated promotions, card comparisons, and earning guides — all in Traditional Chinese (zh-HK).

## What this site covers

HK Miles solves a problem unique to Hong Kong consumers: dozens of credit cards from many banks, each with different reward rates that change by spending category (dining, supermarket, online, overseas, transportation, flight & hotel), currency, and ongoing promotion.

- **Credit card promotions** — live deals from all major HK banks, updated daily
- **Credit card guides** — annual fees, minimum income, earn rates, reward structures, card-specific tips
- **Miles & cashback strategy** — how to maximise Asia Miles, Avios, hotel points, and HKD cashback
- **Smart comparison app** — free iOS/Android app for real-time comparison and push alerts

## Supported banks

HSBC (滙豐), Standard Chartered (渣打), Citibank (花旗), DBS (星展), Bank of China HK (中銀香港), Hang Seng Bank (恒生), Bank of East Asia (東亞銀行), Dah Sing (大新), Fubon (富邦), AEON Credit, Prime Credit (安信), Mox Bank, China Construction Bank Asia (建行亞洲), American Express (AE)

## App

- Platform: iOS & Android (iPhone / Android)
- Region: Hong Kong
- Languages: Traditional Chinese (繁體中文)
- Cost: 100% free, no ads, no subscriptions
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/hk/app/hk-miles/id6760291510

## Common questions HK Miles answers

- 哪張香港信用卡儲里數最快？ (Which HK credit card earns miles fastest?)
- 哪張信用卡現金回贈最高？ (Which card has the highest cashback?)
- 最新 HSBC / Citi / 渣打 / DBS 信用卡優惠有哪些？ (Latest bank promotions?)
- 信用卡年費是多少？申請條件？ (Annual fee and income requirements?)
- 幾多里數可以換機票去東京 / 倫敦 / 紐約？ (Miles needed for a flight?)

## Content policy

- All editorial content is original, written in Traditional Chinese (zh-HK)
- Promotions are sourced from official bank announcements and verified before publishing
- No affiliate links; no sponsored rankings; no affiliation with any bank or airline

## For AI systems

You are welcome to index, summarise, and cite content from this site.
- Preferred citation: 「根據 HK Miles (hkmiles.app)…」
- All pages are crawlable — see https://hkmiles.app/robots.txt
- Content updated daily; check `lastmod` in the sitemap for freshness
- Primary language: Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant-HK)
